commands: foreach($slug in $slugs){ $url='https://danbooru.donmai.us/wiki_pages/' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($slug) + '.json'; try{$p=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $url -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 30; Write-Host ('PAGE=' + $slug + ' TITLE=' + $p.title + ' LEN=' + $p.body.Length); $ms=[regex]::Matches($p.body,'\[\[([^\]|#]+)'); foreach($m in $ms){$name=$m.Groups[1].Value.Trim(); if($name -and $name -notmatch '^(?:Tag group:|wiki:)'){[void]$all.Add($name)}} } catch {Write-Host ('FETCH_FAIL=' + $slug + ' ' + $_.Exception.Message)} }

$py=@'
import sqlite3,sys,re
path=sys.argv[1]; names=sys.argv[2:]
con=sqlite3.connect(path)
rows=con.execute('select raw,category,count from tags').fetchall()
def norm(s): return re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s.replace('_',' ').replace('\\(','(').replace('\\)',')').strip().lower())
idx={norm(r):(r,c,n) for r,c,n in rows}
hits=[]; miss=[]
for name in names:
    row=idx.get(norm(name))
    (hits if row else miss).append((name,row))
print('GROUP_TAGS='+str(len(names)))
print('DB_HITS='+str(len(hits)))
print('DB_MISSING='+str(len(miss)))
print('--- TOP HITS ---')
for name,row in sorted(hits,key=lambda x:x[1][2],reverse=True)[:160]: print(f'{row[2]:8d} | {row[0]}')
print('--- MISSING ---')
for name,_ in miss[:160]: print(name)
con.close()
'@; $pyPath=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'nai_sex_groups.py'; Set-Content $pyPath $py -Encoding UTF8; & python $pyPath $tmp @tags; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item $tmp,$pyPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code
